runtime.yolo_completion_transport: Existing user-configured Mercury FIM adapter in the separately installed YOLO plugin

capture.method: ScreenCaptureKit selected public demo window, no audio

encoding.montage: Cuts omit pauses between independent scenes. Measured waits are continuous within their excerpt.

automatic_compile.comparison_boundary: Different from the one-page Overleaf comparison; not a new matched Overleaf trial.

synctex.forward: Actual preview API source-to-PDF highlight observed in the later scene; no reconstructed animation.

yolo.trigger: Manual Trigger AI completion command via the actual LaTeX Live API
yolo.timing_method: First nonempty suggestion observed by a nominal 10 ms read-only poll; the real ghost is visible in the native video. Rounded demo caption is about 0.50 s. Later automatic controller calls are excluded from this request timing.
yolo.selection: Selected short completion, with the configured 32-token budget unchanged. Earlier attempts and the prior successful short-math take are retained outside Git. This final take starts from valid TeX, avoiding an incomplete math delimiter during the recording. Not a model benchmark.

materials.manuscript: Original short public mathematics demonstration; the fixtures contain the final saved state.
materials.wallpaper: User-supplied Miku artwork shown with permission; only its appearance within the recordings is included. Original artwork and its rights remain separate from the project MIT license.
materials.private_data: Provider credentials, user chat history, private vault files and raw captures are outside Git.
